content: Additionally, to establish the applicability of Wikipedia-based approaches for the Armenian language, we provide evaluation results for 3 different named entity recognition systems trained and tested on our datasets. The results reinforce the ability of deep learning approaches in achieving relatively high recall values for this specific task, as well as the power of using character-extracted embeddings alongside conventional word embeddings.
